Name: DetailTaxValidTaxChange
DetailTaxGetTaxRate
Content:
<action id="GetTaxRate" ><text><![CDATA[
if exists(select 1 from dmthue where ma_thue = @ma_thue)
  begin
    select a.thue_suat, rtrim(a.tk_thue_co) as tk_thue_co, isnull(b.tk_cn, 0) as thue_cn from dmthue a left join dmtk b on a.tk_thue_co = b.tk where a.ma_thue = @ma_thue
    return
  end    
]]></text></action>

Name: DetailTaxGetTaxAccount
Content:
<action id="TaxAccount" ><text><![CDATA[
if exists(select 1 from dmtk where tk = @tk_thue and loai_tk = 1) begin
  select tk_cn from dmtk where tk = @tk_thue
  return
end
]]></text></action>
